-- TTEX Talk Scene File: DO NOT EDIT BY HAND
-- Quest #1000 / Scene #18 - Function Synopsis_Tartaros4
function Synopsis_Tartaros4()
	SetTransitionType(2)
	SetFinalMusic("")
	HideOriginalObjs(1)
	Phase1()

	LoadMap("town000D.fld")
	MoveCamera(0.00, 0.00, 0.00)
	RotCamera(0.00, 1.57, 100.00)

	CreateObject(0, 1478, 331.00, 144.00, 212, 0, FALSE, 1, 1)
	CreateObject(1, 1480, 338.00, 137.00, 212, 0, FALSE, 1, 19)

	Phase2()
	Phase3()
	Phase4()

	PlayCameraNoWait("Synopsis_Town4_01.cam", 0, 0.00, 0.00, 0.00)
	FadeIn(100)
	PlayMusic("BGM031.ogg")
	wait(2000)
	Dialogue(7)
	wait(13000)
	WalkObject(0, 231.000000, 144.000000, 0.000000, 1, 4, 2)
	WalkObject(1, 238.000000, 137.000000, 0.000000, 1, 4, 2)
	wait(22000)

	RevPhase4()
	RevPhase3()
	RevPhase2()

	Q.DeleteAllObject()
	RestoreMap()

	RevPhase1()
end

Register(Synopsis_Tartaros4)
